::: {.hero-text}
I'm Huiseok Moon, a postdoctoral researcher at **Université Paris-Est Créteil
(LISSI)**, working on assistive robotics and physical human-robot interaction.
My path has taken me through mechanical engineering (Sogang University),
robotics (Kwangwoon University), and a Ph.D. on human-in-the-loop mobility
assistance (UPEC), with a postdoctoral stay at **KAIST** along the way.

I like building systems that sit at the boundary between a person and a
machine — where a control law has to be both precise and forgiving, and where
a model has to explain a limp, a hesitation, or a stumble in time to help.
:::
:::
